subject: Execs: OKR ramp & QBR prep — owner asks and gating decisions
thread_messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme-platform.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Execs: OKR ramp & QBR prep — owner asks and gating decisions

Team — attaching the working Q2 OKR slate (v1) and a suggested QBR dry-run agenda. Need three quick items from each owner by EOD Monday so we can lock the slate and finalize the QBR pack: 

1) Confirm owner and one backup for each objective (name + 1-line accountability)
2) Call out any gating dependencies that block measurement or delivery in H1 (third-party integrations, infra, legal)
3) Flag any metric definitions that need clarifying (signal, measurement cadence)

A couple of notes up front: Acme Platform (Emma, copied) has asked for an alignment readout during our QBR; procurement may still be negotiating an expanded commitment (ccing procurement contact below). I want us to be able to give a clean slate and no last-minute metric changes.

Please reply inline. I will compile into v1.1 and do a quick leadership readout Tue morning.

Attachments: Q2_OKR_Slate_v1.xlsx, QBR_dryrun_agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execs: OKR ramp & QBR prep — owner asks and gating decisions

Hannah — thanks. Quick inline: 

- Objective A (Reduce token cost by 18%): Owner = Kimberly Park, Backup = Marcus Lin (ops) — accountability: implementation plan for batching + quantization experiments, clear cost target per pipeline.
- Objective B (95th pctl latency < 120ms): Owner = Markus Klein, Backup = Logan Wright — gating: need infra capacity commitments from Dedicated team (ticket SUP-4821).
- Objective C (Customer adoption > 3 pilots): Owner = Marissa Cole, Backup = Naomi Feldman — gating: legal review of partner terms for two pilots (Acme / BlueRow).

Metric clarifications: for Objective A we should use net-per-token cost after caching; I'll add a short definition to the sheet.

I'll attach a small worksheet with the owner lines and will update the drive.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP Product
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execs: OKR ramp & QBR prep — owner asks and gating decisions

Adding risk notes: 
- On Objective B (latency), we should call out the possible 2–3 week variance in kernel rollout timing for the newest transformer kernels. If that slips, the canary for low-latency paths should be delayed.
- On Objective C (pilots), Acme has asked us to present a technical plan in the QBR; recommend we include a 10-min demo slot and pre-recorded latency/cost numbers. Emma — can you confirm a preferred date range for the readout?

Also proposing we schedule a 30-minute owners alignment call Monday 9:00–9:30 PT to clear open dependencies before I compile the dry run. Anybody opposed?

-Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execs: OKR ramp & QBR prep — owner asks and gating decisions

Hannah — noted. Confirming owner for Objective B. 

On the kernel rollout: I'll escalate infra gating with the serving runtime team and aim to get a firm timeline by EOD Monday (SUP-4821). If it's still uncertain, propose a fallback metric: p99 < 200ms for first-half GA, with an explicit canary plan to drive p95 under 120ms by end of Q2.

I'll join the owners call Monday.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execs: OKR ramp & QBR prep — owner asks and gating decisions

Team — I updated Objective C in the sheet: added pilot milestones (SOW sign, integration sprint, customer validation checkpoint) and assigned Marissa (owner) / Naomi (backup). For Acme specifically, Emma — we propose a technical kickoff the week of May 3rd and an integration window May 10–21. Procurement (procurement@bluerow.com) is still finalizing terms; I'll sync with them this afternoon and flag anything that changes delivery dates.

Also, agree with Grace — include the 10-min demo in the dry run. Happy to own pre-recorded metrics.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Growth
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execs: OKR ramp & QBR prep — owner asks and gating decisions

Thanks all — pulling this into v1.1 now. Owners confirmed:
- Objective A: Kimberly Park (backup Marcus Lin)
- Objective B: Markus Klein (backup Logan Wright) — Markus to confirm kernel timeline (SUP-4821) by EOD Mon
- Objective C: Marissa Cole (backup Naomi Feldman) — Marissa to confirm procurement impacts after sync with procurement contact

Action items: 
- Kimberly: add metric definition row for cost (by Tue 10am)
- Markus: escalate kernel rollout timeline (by Mon EOD)
- Marissa: confirm Acme dates and procurement blockers (by Tue noon)
- Grace: schedule owners alignment call Mon 9:00–9:30 PT and send calendar invite

If we get the confirmations above, I'll lock the slate and finalize the QBR dry-run slides Tue AM and share with execs for a fast sign-off.

Hannah
